summary.answer: Allocate WZAAR_MeritFlare, set class/id/default sound, queue pending state update. Add/store flare then flare2, each a 256x256 image with the same levelup-flare asset and alpha 0. flare uses RGB(1,.39,0); flare2 uses (.98,1,0), Z rotation 180, scale(.5,.5), then ui_add material. Conditionally call PostLoadFunc and return self.
